טבלה: הגדרות פוליסה
This table defines key terms used within the insurance policy. It helps clarify what is covered under definitions like 'Securities' and 'Cash'.
ממדים: Term defined in the policy, Definition of the term

"Securities" shall mean:
Stock, Shares, Scrip, Transfers, Certificates, Debentures, Bonds, Coupons, Warrants, Bills of Exchange, Promissory Notes, Certificates of Deposit, Title Deeds, Bearer Instruments, or  other documents of valley and any other documents of a negotiable nature.
"Cash" shall mean:
Bank Notes, Gold, Silver and other Coins of every description and Cheques.
